title: Pre-existing clippy needless_borrows_for_generic_args at crate-jmap-metadata-types/tests/metadata_types.rs:195
description:
Discovered while running pre-commit gates for JMAP-1j9k.1 (calendars-types Calendar.id/ParticipantIdentity.id Option<Id> fix).

cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings fails on:

  error: the borrowed expression implements the required traits
     --> crate-jmap-metadata-types/tests/metadata_types.rs:195:43
      |
  195 |     let round_trip = serde_json::to_value(&Metadata::Annotation(ann)).unwrap();
      |                                           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ help: change this to: Metadata::Annotation(ann)
      |
      = note: -D clippy::needless-borrows-for-generic-args implied by -D warnings

Verified pre-existing: git stash then re-run produces the same error against HEAD (c13f2a2). The clippy version is rust-1.95.0; the new lint variant tightened in a recent toolchain rollover.

Fix: remove the leading & on the Metadata::Annotation(ann) argument. serde_json::to_value takes &T so passing an owned value works via auto-ref; the explicit & is redundant.

Blocks workspace pre-commit gate. Out of scope for JMAP-1j9k.1; filing separately.
close_reason: Batch 11: committed and adversarially verified (or already fixed); CI green at cc87669d
